origin.description: Add a column of predictions from a fitted model.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Prediction type. Only response is used.

origin.details: The model is fitted with NumPy least squares. A row with a missing predictor is missing in the new column.
origin.value: The same rows, plus the prediction column.
origin.example:
df <- data.frame(x = c(1, 2, NA), y = c(1.5, 2, 3.5))
cat(add_predictions(df, lm(y ~ x, data = df))$pred, "\n")

translation.description: Add a column of predictions from a fitted model.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Prediction type. Only response is used.

translation.details: The model is fitted with NumPy least squares. A row with a missing predictor is missing in the new column.
translation.value: The same rows, plus the prediction column.
translation.example:
data = {"x": [1.0, 2.0, None], "y": [1.5, 2.0, 3.5]}
print(add_predictions(data, lm("y ~ x", data))["pred"])
